label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read instantly as a cross-hilt longsword (pointed tip, upswept guard, wrapped grip, ball pommel); outline is symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0); top view reduces to the guard bar as expected for a blade.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: long blade (big), upswept crossguard (medium), gem, grip wraps, pommel collar and blade fuller (small).
evidence.V3: Upswept guard tips and chunky pommel add some stylisation, but the blade is long, narrow and near-realistic, so at 64 px the guard/pommel read small against a thin blade; only partly exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on the guard edges and tip flares, blade bevel and fuller edges catch light, pommel collar bevelled; no razor or blobby areas.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (guard studio/flat, blade mid, tip, pommel) show smooth shading, clean fuller and gem seating, no seams, pinches or z-fighting; only the low-segment pommel outline is slightly polygonal.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: steel greys (blade + darker fuller), gold guard/pommel, one hue (teal) for wraps and gem; colourways swap only the accent hue.
evidence.V7: 2452 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/steel/accent palette, ~kit chamfer size and smooth shading; matches the anchors' style.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Tool Handle, origin at grip, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic - correct.

artifacts: Pommel sphere outline slightly polygonal in close-up (minor, not a shading artifact)
200 cross-shell overlaps reported (intentional blade-into-guard 0.225 and gem 0.03 penetrations; no visible artifact)
top_fixes: Push stylised proportion: widen the blade (or add a stronger taper/flare) and enlarge guard and pommel so the hilt reads at 64 px
Add a couple of segments to the pommel sphere for a rounder outline
Give the guard a stronger silhouette accent (e.g. larger end finials) to differentiate from generic longswords
